description: Validates UI5 manifest file. After making changes, you should always run the validation again to verify that no new problems have been introduced.

manifestPath.description: Absolute path to the manifest file to validate.

name: run_manifest_validation

errors.description: Array of validation error objects as returned by Ajv.

instancePath.description: JSON Pointer to the location in the data instance (e.g., `/prop/1/subProp`).

params.description: An object with additional information about the error.

propertyName.description: Set for errors in `propertyNames` keyword schema.

schemaPath.description: JSON Pointer to the location of the failing keyword in the schema.

isValid.description: Whether the manifest is valid according to the UI5 Manifest schema.

title: Manifest Validation
